summary: First-run full-stack testing of Mahaveer Hospital Laravel 11 + MySQL CMS. 36/36 backend HTTP/pytest tests passed and full Playwright UI walkthrough of public site, contact form, admin login (both wrong and correct credentials), admin dashboard, doctors listing, and enquiries page passed. Contact form submission persisted to enquiries table and appeared in admin dashboard 'Latest Enquiries' section immediately.

minor.issue: Slug 'laravel-cms-portal' referenced in the test spec does not exist in seeded data. Actual seeded doctor slugs are dr-anjali-verma, dr-amardeep, dr-rakesh-kumar, dr-sunita-sharma, dr-vinay-singh. Doctor detail page works fine with real slugs (verified 200 OK). This is a spec/documentation mismatch, not a code bug.

issues: A few resources return HTTP 400 in browser console (likely optional icon/asset requests). Non-blocking, page renders correctly with ivory bg rgb(251,249,244).

action_items: Optional: seed a doctor with slug 'laravel-cms-portal' OR update problem statement/test spec to use one of the actual seeded slugs (e.g. dr-anjali-verma).
Optional: investigate the 3 console 400 resource errors on home page (probably missing icon/asset URLs).
critical_code_review_comments: Route file is clean and well-organized; admin routes properly wrapped in auth:admin middleware. Guest access to /admin/doctors correctly 302-redirects to /admin/login.
CSRF enforced on all POST/PUT/DELETE (verified by tests extracting _token from forms).
Doctor CRUD end-to-end verified: create -> appears on public /doctors -> edit -> delete all return 302 redirects as expected.

Contact enquiry persistence confirmed both at backend (POST /contact -> flash success) and via admin dashboard 'Latest Enquiries' widget showing TEST_UI User and TEST_Contact User records within seconds of submission.
Light theme validated: no data-testid='dark-toggle', no 'prefers-color-scheme: dark' rules, body bg = ivory across pages.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Contact User and TEST_UI User enquiries via /contact form; both visible in /admin/enquiries. Doctor CRUD test created and then deleted TEST_Dr Pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, hits public Base URL). Run: `cd /app && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Admin session fixture handles CSRF-based Laravel login. Seeded doctor slugs are dr-anjali-verma/dr-amardeep/dr-rakesh-kumar/dr-sunita-sharma/dr-vinay-singh (NOT 'laravel-cms-portal' as spec claims). MySQL DB is 'mahaveer_cms'.
rca of the issue: The single spec deviation (doctor slug 'laravel-cms-portal' returning 404) is a specification/seed mismatch: DatabaseSeeder generates realistic doctor names with 'dr-*' slugs; the review request's example slug was fictional. No application bug. Reproduction: GET /doctors/laravel-cms-portal -> 404 (expected, no such record). Mitigation: use real slug or add a seeded doctor with that slug.
